prompt: What is the status of US banking third-party risk management guidance as of November 2026?
assertions: States the June 2023 Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships remains the operative framework
Describes the proposal published in the Federal Register September 15, 2026 (91 FR 58536) that would rescind and replace it

Notes the NCUA joins the proposal (it was not party to the 2023 guidance) and that the proposal would also rescind the OCC foreign-based third-party bulletin, the 2024 bank-fintech joint statement, and the 2024 community bank TPRM guide
Advises against restructuring programs before a final document, while considering a comment submission
